payload.title: Equipment Oversizing
payload.full_text:
(See Note A-8.4.5.8.)
1) The heating equipment of the reference building shall be modeled as being oversized by the lesser of
a) the percentage of oversizing applied to the proposed building, or
b) 30%.
2) The cooling equipment of the reference building shall be modeled as being oversized by the lesser of
a) the percentage of oversizing applied to the proposed building, or
b) 10%.
